title: Beneath the Tokens phase-two evidence manifest
description: A versioned, reviewable map from a chapter claim to a pinned source or reproducible experiment.

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Increment only when the manifest contract changes.

chapter_id.description: Stable chapter id shared with the Markdown frontmatter.

evidence.title: Evidence entry
evidence.description: One claim and the source, version, experiment, and limitation needed to review it.

claim.description: A single factual, definitional, derived, measured, or explicitly judged statement.

type.description: How the claim should be read; this is not a confidence score.

source_url.description: Canonical paper, documentation, repository, or experiment record URL.

version.description: Pinned release, tag, commit, paper version, or RFC identifier; branch names are not acceptable.

experiment_id.description: Stable lab/run identifier, or null when the claim is not experimental.

limitation.description: What this evidence does not establish, including portability or causal limits.

review_date.description: Date on which the source and claim were last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).
